programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: On this episode of Eric Mintel Investigates, Lead investigator Eric Mintel and Spirit Medium, Dominic Sattele travel to the beautiful town Manchester, CT to investigate the historic Cheney Hall. Later Spirit medium Dominic Sattele joins the team with magnetometer readings that go off the charts in the areas where the creature has been sighted. What follows is a whirlwind investigation leaving the team speechless!
